annotations.title: Find senior care facilities near a place

description: Find licensed nursing homes, assisted living and memory care near a US town, county or ZIP, from state and Medicare public records. Results come in the same order as the search on kovante.com. Every home links to its full record on Kovante.

max_monthly_budget.description: Whole dollars a month; compared with the modeled estimate.

place.description: A US town and state ("Round Rock, TX"), a county and state ("Travis County, TX") or a 5-digit ZIP.
